trainerQueue.label: My trainings to move
trainerQueue.empty: No training to move, for now.

approvalQueue.empty: No request is waiting for you.

report.noSheet: The sheet of this rating had no items when the report was published: it has the comments and the boxes.

refusal.bannedForever: The ban holds until the training department lifts it.
refusal.open: Once that training is closed, you can ask for another one.
refusal.waitUntil_one: You can ask for the next training from {{date}} UTC: {{count}} day to go.
refusal.waitUntil_other: You can ask for the next training from {{date}} UTC: {{count}} days to go.

refusal.hoursNeeded: This training asks for {{minimum}} connection hours.

request.title: Ask for a training
request.lead: Choose the path and say when you are free: the training department receives the request, checks it and assigns you a trainer. Before a training you must have passed the theory exam of the rating.
request.youHint: They come from the network at your last sign in and are changed there: they are updated here when you sign in again.
request.nothingNext: No training to ask for after your rating
request.sent: Request for the {{rating}} training sent: the training department will check it.

hints.position: Type to search among the positions the division trains this rating on.
hints.availabilityText: When you can do the training: days and times, with the time zone.
hints.notesText: What the training department or the trainer should know.

theory.question: Have you passed the theory exam for {{rating}}?
theory.description: Before a training you must have passed the theory exam of the rating. Whoever approves the request checks it.

declined.title: Before asking for the training you must pass the {{rating}} theory exam.
declined.description: The request is recorded as refused, and no email is sent. Once you have passed the theory exam, ask for the training again.

mine.title: My trainings
mine.lead: Your requests and your trainings, ATC and pilot: what you can ask for on each path, and how each request is going.
mine.none: You have not asked for a training yet.
mine.noneDescription: When you ask for one, you find the request here and how it goes on.
mine.canAsk: You can ask for the training
mine.readyForExamOn: Your trainer marked you ready for the {{rating}} exam.
mine.theoryRefusal: Refused by the hub: you answered that you had not passed the theory exam yet.
mine.reportReady: Your trainer has published the report.
mine.cancelDescription: It stays among your trainings as cancelled, and makes you wait for nothing: you can ask for another one whenever you like.
mine.closedUnanswered: Closed by the hub: you did not choose a date among the ones your trainer proposed in the time the division gives to choose one.
mine.datesWaiting_one: Your trainer proposed {{count}} date: choose yours.
mine.datesWaiting_other: Your trainer proposed {{count}} dates: choose yours.

detail.title: {{kind}} {{rating}} training

next.Requested: The training department will check the request, the theory exam included, and write to you when it is accepted or refused. Until somebody accepts it, you can cancel it.
next.Accepted: A trainer will be assigned to you, and you will receive an email then too.
next.Assigned: Your trainer will propose the dates of the session: you will receive an email, and choose one of them here.
next.Scheduled: You will receive a reminder before the session. Only your trainer changes a date once it is fixed: if it no longer suits you, write to them.
next.Held: The session is over: your trainer will write the report.
next.Completed: The training is completed: your trainer's report is below.
next.NoShow: Your trainer marked the session as a no-show, because you were not there: the training is closed without a report.

detail.askAgain: You can ask for the next training on this path whenever you want.

dates.title: Choose the date of the session
dates.lead: Your trainer proposed these dates. Choose one: the session is fixed, and you both receive an email. If none of them suits you, write to your trainer.
dates.confirmDescription: Your trainer receives an email, and so do you. Only your trainer changes a date once it is fixed.
dates.moved: Your trainer changed the dates meanwhile: look at the ones there are now.

staff.title: Requests and trainings
staff.description: Every training of the division, from the request to the report: accept or refuse a request, assign the trainer, propose the dates of the session, write the report, close a training.
staff.reserved: This training is yours: the notes the staff writes for itself — on the sheet, in the report and on a session rescheduled — are not shown to you.

theoryReminder.title: Before accepting, check that {{trainee}} has passed the {{rating}} theory exam.
theoryReminder.declared: The trainee declared it passed on {{date}}.

decision.theory: Refused by the hub on {{date}}: the trainee answered that the theory exam was not passed yet.

trainer.none: No trainer yet: an accepted training waits for one as long as it takes.
trainer.noCandidates: Nobody can train it now: the staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once and has a rating on this path at least {{rating}}.
trainer.noOtherCandidates: Nobody else can train it now: the staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once and has a rating on this path at least {{rating}}.

assign.assigned: Trainer assigned: {{name}}. They will be asked to sign in again before they can conduct it.

hints.trainerVid: The staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once, with a rating on this path at least the one trained. The trainer is written to, and so is the trainee.

accept.title: Accept the request?
accept.description: The trainee is told by email. A trainer is assigned afterwards, whenever one is found.

reject.title: Refuse the request?
reject.description: The reason goes to the trainee by email and on their trainings page. A refusal makes them wait for nothing.

hints.reason: As the trainee will read it: for example, the connection hours they still need.

session.title: The session
session.chosen: The trainee chose the date among the ones proposed.
session.byHand: The date was set by hand.
session.held: Held: the session is over, and the training waits for its report.
session.recordable: The session has started: record how it went. Held: write the report below. Too little traffic: reschedule it. The trainee did not come: mark a no-show.

reschedule.title: Reschedule the session?
reschedule.description: For too little traffic: the session stays among the ones that are over, with your notes, and the training waits for its date again — propose new dates. No report, and the trainee receives no email: the next one is the dates proposed.
reschedule.done: Session rescheduled: propose the new dates.

hints.notes: For the staff and the trainers only: the trainee never reads them. They may be left empty.

noShow.title: Mark the session as a no-show?
noShow.description: The trainee did not come: the training closes without a report, the trainee receives an email, and waits the days of a no-show before asking again.
noShow.done: No-show recorded: the training is closed.

report.lead: For each item of the sheet: a grade from 1 to 5 for practice; done, not done or to improve for theory; N/A when the session did not touch it. Then a comment the trainee reads, and a note for the staff they never read. Last, the report as a whole: there is no pass or fail.
report.noItems: The sheet of this rating has no items: the report has the comments and the boxes only. The training department writes the items in the evaluation sheet.
report.publishDescription: The trainee reads it straight away on the page of the training and receives an email; the notes and the comment for the staff never reach them. The training is completed, and the report is not changed afterwards.
report.done: Report published: the trainee receives an email.

hints.generalComment: How the session went as a whole, as the trainee will read it.
hints.staffComment: For the staff and the trainers only: the trainee never reads it.

dates.none: No date proposed: the trainee chooses among the ones whoever conducts the training proposes here.
dates.passed: Gone by: the trainee can no longer choose it.
dates.noWarnings: No warning when it was proposed.

met.confirmTitle: Something is in the calendar on those days already: look at the warnings, and confirm if the dates are fine all the same.
met.refusedTitle: Something is in the calendar on those days already, and the division does not accept a date that meets it: change the dates marked.

withdraw.title: Take back the date of {{when}} UTC?
withdraw.description: The trainee no longer sees it among the ones to choose from, and receives no email.

propose.title: Propose dates
propose.lead: The trainee receives them by email and chooses theirs among the tiles of their page: 10 at a time at most, 12 hours long at most each. They are written in UTC; under each field, the time in {{zone}}.
propose.done_one: {{count}} date proposed to the trainee: they receive an email.
propose.done_other: {{count}} dates proposed to the trainee: they receive an email.

setByHand.title: Set the date by hand
setByHand.lead: Also outside the dates proposed, and in the past too, for a session held earlier than planned. The dates proposed go, and the trainee and the trainer receive an email. It is written in UTC; under the field, the time in {{zone}}.

close.title: Close the training?
close.description: The trainee receives an email with the reason, and reads it on their trainings page. The session fixed and the dates proposed go; a closing makes them wait for nothing.

hints.reason: As the trainee will read it: for example, that they chose no date among the ones proposed.

closing.byHub: Closed by the hub on {{date}}: the trainee chose no date in the time the division gives to choose one.

trainees.title: Trainees
trainees.description: The path of a trainee: where they stand on each path, every training of theirs with its report, and their bans.

hints.vid: The member's VID: their path opens even with no training yet, to ban them.

trainees.pathDescription: Where the trainee stands on each path, their bans, and every training of theirs by path and rating.
trainees.readyForExamOn: Ready for the {{rating}} exam, marked by the trainer: the exam is booked on the network's site.

standing.mockExam: It will be a mock exam, as agreed with the trainer.
standing.bannedUntil: Banned from the training until {{date}} UTC.
standing.bannedForever: Banned from the training until somebody lifts the ban.
standing.open: Has a training open on this path.
standing.waiting: Waiting after the last training on this path.
standing.waitingUntil: Waiting after the last training on this path: can ask again from {{date}} UTC.
standing.hours: This training asks for {{minimum}} connection hours, and they have {{hours}}.
standing.hoursUnknown: This training asks for {{minimum}} connection hours, and the hub does not know theirs.
standing.noPosition: At the moment the division offers no position to train this rating on.
standing.nothingToAsk: There is no training to ask for on this path after their rating.

trainees.banForever: From {{from}} UTC, until somebody lifts it

bans.title: Bans
bans.description: The members banned from asking for trainings, on every path: while a ban holds they ask for nothing, and the trainings they have open go on. A ban is never changed nor deleted: to change one, lift it and give another.
bans.formDescription: The member reads the reason and the end in an email, and asks for no training on any path until the end — or, without one, until somebody lifts the ban.
bans.liftDescription: The member may ask for trainings again at once. The ban stays in their history, with who lifted it and when.

hints.vid: Whom the ban is for. Nobody bans themselves.
hints.reason: As the member will read it in the email.
hints.endsAt: Left empty, the ban holds until somebody lifts it.

exams.title: Exams
exams.description: The exams in the division's calendar. The exam itself is booked, held and graded on the network: here it is only put in the calendar. Whoever examines enters their own exams; an advisor changes and takes off the calendar only the exams assigned to them. Of the candidate and of the examiner, the VID only.
exams.formDescription: The exam goes into the public calendar by its rating, position, date and time, with nobody's name or VID; signed in members read the two VIDs on the training page.

hints.rating: The rating examined: only the ratings with a practical training can be chosen.
hints.position: For an ATC exam only: a position of the division the rating is trained on. Empty for a pilot's exam.
hints.candidateVid: Who is examined, by VID only. Nobody examines themselves.
hints.examinerVid: The exam is assigned to them: they change it and take it off the calendar. An advisor enters only their own exams.

delete.title: Take the exam off the calendar?
delete.description: The exam leaves the calendar of the hub. The exam itself stays as it is on the network.

sheets.title: Evaluation sheet
sheets.description: The items a trainer marks after a session, per path and rating: the practical ones with a grade from 1 to 5, the theory ones as done, not done or to improve. The trainee reads them in their report.

hints.rating: The sheet the item is on: only the ratings with a practical training can be chosen.
hints.section: How the trainer marks the item: practice with a grade from 1 to 5, theory as done, not done or to improve.
hints.title: As the trainer and the trainee read it, in every language of the division.
hints.sort: The place of the item in the sheet of its rating: lower numbers first.
hints.isActive: An item switched off is left out of new reports; the reports already written keep it as it was.

delete.title: Delete the item?
delete.description: Only an item no report has used is deleted; an item already used is switched off.

settings.title: Training settings
settings.description: What the training department changes without a release: the rules of a request, the times of the dates, the positions trained on.

fields.minimumHours: Minimum hours to ask for a training
fields.cooldownDays: Days to wait after a training
fields.noShowCooldownDays: Days to wait after a no-show
fields.maxResponseDays: Days to choose a date before the training closes
fields.responseReminderDays: Days without a chosen date before the trainer is alerted
fields.conflictPolicy: When a proposed date meets the calendar
fields.reminderLeadHours: Hours before a session the reminder is sent

hints.minimumHours: Connection hours as a controller for an ATC rating, as a pilot for a pilot rating. A member with fewer cannot ask for that rating. No row: no threshold.
hints.maxResponseDays: Empty: a training never closes by itself, and the staff closes it by hand.
hints.conflictKinds: A proposed date that falls on an entry of one of these kinds is handled as the setting above says.
hints.hiddenPositions: The trainees are offered every position of the division a rating is trained on, the military ones included, except these.
hints.theoryExamUrl: Shown with the question on the theory exam, and to whoever approves a request.

conflictPolicy.Warn: Warn, and let the trainer confirm

errors.ratingNotTrained: This rating has no practical training.
errors.ratingTwice: This rating has more than one row.
errors.positionUnknown: The division no longer trains on this position: take it out of the list.
errors.calendarKindUnknown: One of these is not a kind of the calendar.
errors.sheetItemUsed: A report has already used this item: switch it off instead of deleting it.
errors.requestBanned: You have a ban from the training: while it holds you cannot ask for a training.
errors.requestOpen: You already have a training open on this path: one at a time.
errors.requestWaiting: The waiting after your last training on this path is not over yet.
errors.requestNothingToAsk: There is no training to ask for on this path after your rating.
errors.requestHoursUnknown: The hub does not know your connection hours yet: sign out and sign in again.
errors.requestHoursTooFew: You do not have the connection hours this training asks for yet.
errors.requestNoPosition: At the moment the division offers no position to train this rating on.
errors.requestRatingNotNext: This is no longer the rating you may ask for: reload the page.
errors.requestPositionUnknown: Choose a position from the list.
errors.requestPositionNotAsked: A training on this path has no position.
errors.requestNotCancellable: Only a request nobody has accepted yet can be cancelled.
errors.trainingNotRequested: Only a request waiting for acceptance can be accepted or refused.
errors.trainingNotAssignable: A trainer is assigned only to an accepted training that is still going on.
errors.trainerIsTrainee: Nobody is the trainer of their own training.
errors.trainerNotStaff: Only the staff of the training who has signed in to the hub at least once can be the trainer.
errors.trainerRatingTooLow: Their rating on this path is below the one this training is for.
errors.trainerAlready: They are the trainer of this training already.
errors.datesNotProposable: Dates are proposed only for a training with its trainer assigned and no date yet.
errors.slotPassed: This date has already gone by.
errors.slotEndsBeforeItStarts: The end comes before the start.
errors.slotTooLong: A date proposed lasts 12 hours at most.
errors.slotTwice: This date is among the ones proposed already.
errors.slotsTooMany: At most 10 dates are proposed to the trainee at a time.
errors.slotUnknown: This date is no longer among the ones proposed: reload the page.
errors.slotNotChoosable: A date is chosen only while the training waits for its date.
errors.dateNotSettable: A date is set only on a training with its trainer assigned that is still going on.
errors.dateBlocked: Something is in the calendar on that day already, and the division does not accept a date that meets it.
errors.dateNotConfirmed: Something is in the calendar on that day already: look at the warnings and confirm the date.
errors.trainingNotClosable: Only an accepted training that is still going on can be closed.
errors.sessionNotRecordable: What a session came to is recorded only on a dated training, once its session has started.
errors.reportMockExamAgain: This training is a mock exam already: the one after it is not another mock exam.
errors.sheetChanged: The sheet of this training changed meanwhile: reload the page.
errors.evaluationGradeOnTheory: An item of theory has no grade: it is marked done, not done or to improve.
errors.evaluationMarkOnPractice: An item of practice is not marked done: it has a grade from 1 to 5.
errors.banEndsInThePast: The end of the ban has already gone by.
errors.banAlreadyHolds: A ban already holds on this member: lift it before giving another.
errors.banNotHolding: This ban no longer holds: there is nothing to lift.
errors.examPositionNotAsked: An exam on this path has no position.
errors.examinerIsCandidate: Nobody examines themselves: the examiner is not the candidate.
errors.examinerNotExaminer: Only somebody who puts exams in the calendar, and has signed in to the hub at least once, can be the examiner.

requestReceived.description: An email when a request of yours for a training is received.

requestAccepted.title: My requests accepted
requestAccepted.description: An email when the training department accepts a request of yours for a training.

requestRejected.title: My requests refused
requestRejected.description: An email, with the reason, when the training department refuses a request of yours for a training.

trainerAssigned.title: Trainers assigned
trainerAssigned.description: An email when a trainer is assigned to a training of yours, or you are assigned a training as its trainer.

datesProposed.title: Dates proposed by the trainer
datesProposed.description: An email when the trainer proposes the dates of the session of a training of yours.

dateConfirmed.title: Dates of the sessions
dateConfirmed.description: An email when the date of a training session is fixed, as its trainee or as its trainer.

reminder.title: Reminders of the sessions
reminder.description: An email before a training session, as its trainee or as its trainer.

trainingClosed.title: Trainings closed
trainingClosed.description: An email when a training of yours is closed without a report.

reportPublished.title: Training reports
reportPublished.description: An email when the trainer publishes the report of a training of yours.

banned.title: Bans from the training
banned.description: An email, with the reason and until when, when the training department bans you from asking for trainings.
